query:
SELECT
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
                FROM job_queue
                WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
                  AND enqueue_request IS NULL
            ) AS "job_count!",
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint
                FROM workflow_runs
                WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
                  AND enqueue_request IS NULL
            ) AS "workflow_count!"
